test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 4(2)/(5) years at the rate of 9.5% p.a. is Rs. 3,553. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at 8.4% p.a. simple interest in 7(1)/(2) years?
solution:
**Given:**

S.I. for 4 2/5 years at 9.5% rate is Rs3553 

**Formula used:**

S.I. = ( P ×R ×T )/100 

Amount = S.I.+ P 

Where, S.I. = Simple interest 

P = Principle 

R = Rate of interest 

T = Time in years 

**Calculation:**

Here, we have time = 22/5 years , Rate = 9.5% , S.I. = Rs3553 

S.I. = ( P× R ×T)/100 

⇒ 3553 = ( P × 9.5 × 22/5) /100 

⇒ P = 8500 

Now, P = Rs8500 , Rate = 8.4% , Time = 7.5 years 

S.I. = ( 8500 × 8.4 ×7.5) /100 = Rs5355 

Amount payable = 8500 + 5355 = Rs13,855

**Hence, amount payable is Rs13,855.**
